capabilities.title: Plan a consent-aware storefront-to-email connection
capabilities.delivers: A source/receiver library prototype supports signed, owner-decided changes in synthetic tests; no live farm or email adapter.
capabilities.requires: Requires provider credentials owned by the operator, opt-in and suppression checks, and a separately authorized destination.

capabilities.title: Inspect a separately decided signed crossing
capabilities.delivers: Documents local receiver HOLD/ADMIT/REFUSE and signed evidence, not a public claims service.
capabilities.requires: Ownership, signatures and receiver policy are required; no automatic acceptance.
